dedupe_keys.name: time varying grid co2 emission factors from tso level generation mix in japan fy2024

description: This data set gives hourly grid carbon intensity for each of Japan's nine transmission system operator service areas for fiscal year 2024, from April 2024 to March 2025. It was published on Zenodo in 2026 by Yuto Ihara, Yu Fujimoto, Soma Sugano, Masataka Mitsuoka and Yasuhiro Hayashi. The areas are those of Hokkaido Electric Power Network, Tohoku Electric Power Network, TEPCO Power Grid, Chubu Electric Power Grid, Hokuriku, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyushu transmission and distribution companies. Values are CO2 emission factors in kilograms per kilowatt hour that change hourly with the observed generation mix, calculated from public TSO hourly generation by fuel and fuel-specific emission coefficients as a weighted average, so the series captures short-term swings in grid emissions. Coverage is Japan by TSO area. Files are one CSV per area with a readme and auxiliary data, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: only one fiscal year is covered, factors are average, not marginal, and inter-area exchanges are not attributed. Simulation uses are carbon-aware scheduling of flexible loads, storage and EV charging and emission accounting in planning studies. Related records: data-csiro-nem-consumption-emissions-intensity gives a comparable Australian series.
